      public List<Player> initObjectiveCards()

    • playCard

      public Player playCard(int indexCard, int angle, String targetID, int side) throws InvalidArgumentException, TargetNotPresentException, InvalidAngleCoveredException, InvalidPositionException, RequirementsNotRespectedException
      This method: 1. plays the card that's found at the index position of the cards list (Player) 2. plays that specific card by the front or the back (depending on the side parameter --> ...) 3. plays that specific card covering the angle (parameter) of the card that's specified by the targetID
      Specified by:
      playCard in interface GameObservable
      Parameters:
      indexCard - : index of the card that you want to play that's found into the cards list (list of the playable cards of that specific player)
      angle - : this attribute stands for the angle that you want to cover by positioning the card you're playing
      targetID - : this attribute stands for the card ID of the card that you want to cover by playing the card
      side - : this attribute specifies if the player want to play the card by the front or the back
      Returns:
      the current player that's just played the card
      Throws:
      TargetNotPresentException - if the target is not present
      InvalidAngleCoveredException - if positioning the angle in that spot is incorrect
      InvalidPositionException - if positioning the card in that spot is incorrect
      RequirementsNotRespectedException - if the requirements are not satisfied
      InvalidArgumentException - if the index of the card is incorrect

    • pickCard

      public Player pickCard(int deck) throws FinishedCardStackException, InvalidArgumentException
      This method picks the card from the top of the specified deck (deck). Once this method retrieved the correct new card, it adds that to the current player's card list.
      Specified by:
      pickCard in interface GameObservable
      Parameters:
      deck - : this attribute stands for the specific deck that you want to pick a card from
      Returns:
      the current player that's just picked the card
      Throws:
      FinishedCardStackException - if the deck's done
      InvalidArgumentException - if the deck is not 0 or 1

    • pickCard

      public Player pickCard(int deck, int visibleCardIndex) throws FinishedCardStackException, InvalidArgumentException
      This method picks up one of the two visible cards (shown on the table). Specifically: 1. it picks the visible card of the specific deck (deck) --> which could be the gold or resource deck 2. it picks the visible card (of that specific deck) that's found at the index position of the arraylist of the visible cards --> array of only two elements so the index could only be 0 or 1
      Specified by:
      pickCard in interface GameObservable
      Parameters:
      deck - : the deck where the player wants to pick up the card from (which could be gold or resource)
      visibleCardIndex - : the index position of the card that's been chosen by the player
      Returns:
      : the player that's just picked the card
      Throws:
      FinishedCardStackException - if there aren't any visible cards available
      InvalidArgumentException - if the index chosen by the user is incorrect
